## function for exporting tables

```{r}

export_df_to_latex <- function(df, file_path, caption = NULL) {
  
  #-----------------------------
  # Helper: escape LaTeX specials
  #-----------------------------
  escape_latex <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
    x <- gsub("([%&_#\\$])", "\\\\\\1", x)
    x <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", x)
    return(x)
  }
  
  # Convert to character
  df[] <- lapply(df, as.character)
  
  # Escape LaTeX characters
  df[] <- lapply(df, escape_latex)
  colnames(df) <- escape_latex(colnames(df))
  
  # Alignment: first left, rest right
  n_cols <- ncol(df)
  align_string <- paste0("l", paste(rep("r", n_cols - 1), collapse = ""))
  
  # Build body rows
  body_rows <- apply(df, 1, function(row) {
    paste(row, collapse = " & ")
  })
  
  body_rows <- paste0(body_rows, " \\\\")
  body_text <- paste(body_rows, collapse = "\n")
  
  # Header row
  header <- paste(colnames(df), collapse = " & ")
  header <- paste0(header, " \\\\")
  
  # Caption + label handling
  file_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  
  if (is.null(caption)) {
    caption_text <- gsub("_", " ", file_name)
  } else {
    caption_text <- caption
  }
  
  label <- paste0("tab:", file_name)
  
  # Build LaTeX table
  latex_table <- paste0(
"\\begin{table}[t]
\\centering
\\fontsize{12pt}{14pt}\\selectfont
\\begin{tabular}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}", align_string, "}
\\toprule
", header, "
\\midrule\\addlinespace[2.5pt]
", body_text, "
\\bottomrule
\\end{tabular}
\\caption{", caption_text, "}
\\label{", label, "}
\\end{table}"
  )
  
  # Write file
  writeLines(latex_table, file_path)
  
  message("LaTeX table exported to: ", file_path)
}



```

## make tpu_collapsed spatial

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tigris)   # easiest way to get US county shapes
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

counties_sf <- counties(cb = TRUE, year = 2022) %>%
  st_as_sf()

tpu_collapsed <- tpu_collapsed %>%
  mutate(
    State.Code_str  = sprintf("%02s", State.Code),
    County.Code_str = sprintf("%03s", County.Code),
    GEOID = paste0(State.Code_str, County.Code_str)
  )

tpu_sf <- tpu_collapsed %>%
  left_join(
    counties_sf %>% select(GEOID, geometry),
    by = "GEOID"
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf()

plot(tpu_sf["Net.Reporting.Level.Amount"])

save(tpu_sf, file=here("data/outputs/tpu_sf.rda"))


```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tigris)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

#---------------------------
# 1) Texas boundary
#---------------------------
tx_sf <- states(cb = TRUE, year = 2022) %>%
  filter(STUSPS == "TX") %>%
  st_as_sf()

#---------------------------
# 3) Pecos County boundary
#   FIPS: 48-371
#---------------------------
pecos_boundary <- tpu_sf %>%
  filter(State.Code == "48",
         County.Code == "371") %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf()


#---------------------------
# 5) Match CRS
#---------------------------
tx_sf           <- st_transform(tx_sf, st_crs(usdm))
pecos_boundary  <- st_transform(pecos_boundary, st_crs(usdm))
grids_intersecting_rates <- st_transform(grids_intersecting, st_crs(usdm))


#---------------------------
# 2) Clip USDM to Texas
#---------------------------
usdm_tx <- st_intersection(usdm, tx_sf)



#---------------------------
# 4) CPC grids intersecting Pecos
#---------------------------
grids_pecos <- grids_intersecting_rates[
  st_intersects(grids_intersecting_rates,
                pecos_boundary,
                sparse = FALSE),
]

grids_pecos     <- st_transform(grids_pecos, st_crs(usdm))

#---------------------------
# 6) USDM color palette
#---------------------------

usdm_tx <- usdm_tx %>%
  mutate(
    DM = factor(DM,
                levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4),
                labels = c("D0", "D1", "D2", "D3", "D4"))
  )

#---------------------------
# USDM color palette
#---------------------------
usdm_cols <- c(
  "D0" = "#FFFF00",
  "D1" = "#FCD37F",
  "D2" = "#FFAA00",
  "D3" = "#E60000",
  "D4" = "#730000"
)

#---------------------------
# 7) Plot
#---------------------------
p_map_3_datasets <- ggplot() +

  # USDM polygons (clipped to TX)
  geom_sf(data = usdm_tx,
          aes(fill = DM),
          color = NA) +

  # CPC grid boundaries (blue)
  geom_sf(data = grids_pecos,
          fill = NA,
          color = "blue",
          linewidth = 0.4) +

  # Pecos County boundary
  geom_sf(data = pecos_boundary,
          fill = NA,
          color = "black",
          linewidth = 1.2) +

  # Texas boundary
  geom_sf(data = tx_sf,
          fill = NA,
          color = "black",
          linewidth = 0.8) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = usdm_cols,
                    na.value = "white") +

  coord_sf() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "USDM Classification June 7 2011",
    subtitle = "Pecos County, Texas",
    fill = "USDM"
  )

p_map_3_datasets

png(here("data/outputs/figures/p_map_3_datasets.png"),
    width = 800,
    height = 800)
plot(p_map_3_datasets)
dev.off()


```
